craft_notes: Sthāyin: reason surrendering to all-knowing. Device: colon→dash (creed held, asking released); tvayā kept instrumental-honest. Rejected: 'to thee' dative smoothing — killed: form kept honest per argmap; L2 may render freely, L4 may not. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: All-wise, all-working, all thou art, say the knowers —
what to ken, what to do, lord, for the endless, offered by thee?
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛt sarvam asīti jñānaśālinām vedyaṃ kiṃ karma vā nātha nānantyāya tvayārpyate

reads_against.argmap: All-knowing, all-doing, all you are — thus, of knowers.; What knowable, what karma, O Lord — for endlessness, offered by you? → You are all-knowing, all-doing, all; nothing remains but endless offering.
c1_essence: All-knowing, all-doing, all: nothing left but endless offering.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with prasāda (grace received and returned)

reads_against.t1: All-knowing, all-doing, all is you — thus for knowers of knowledge: what knowable or karma, O Lord, for endlessness, is offered?
